extra.m1_00: ROCK: each tier one flat rose-red tone edge to edge (no gradient, no light edge); the lower band flat terracotta; NO cracks, NO strata texture, NO speckles. BOULDER: flat grey-brown, one single darker groove line only where the geometry has a groove.
